results.description:
She told him he had bad manners. He told her she was trouble. They were both right.

Nora Ellis doesn't need a motorcycle club. She needs her linen route to run on time, her eleven women to keep their jobs, and her deadbeat brother's forty-thousand-dollar debt to disappear. But when a stolen-iron kingpin sends collectors to her loading dock, the president of the Tombstone MC steps between her and the violence — and refuses to step back.

Boothill hasn't wanted anything for himself in twenty years. He built his club to protect the people the system forgot, and he's kept every woman at arm's length to do it. Then a loud, stubborn laundry boss walks into his parking lot and rearranges his entire world in one afternoon.

She won't stay behind his walls. He won't let her out of his sight. And the man who wants her dead isn't going to stop sending crews until one of them doesn't come home.

As the body count rises and the threats close in, Nora discovers that the most dangerous man in the Arizona desert is the one who'd burn down everything he's built to keep her safe — and that the safest place she's ever stood is right beside him. But claiming the president of an outlaw MC means accepting a life where violence is the price of protection and the man she loves carries a darkness he may never shake.

She's going to argue with him about it for the rest of her life.

Boothill's Fury is Book 1 of the Tombstone MC series. Guaranteed HEA. No cliffhanger.
